purpose: Game-safe universal family vocabulary coverage. Every canonical language has the same broad relationship concept inventory here; richer Tier 1 and Tier 2 target profiles separately add culture, usage, distinctions, and examples.

safety.tier1_tier2: The universal row is for cross-language games and broad vocabulary display. Production exercises may use the richer target profile only when its structured features prove a unique answer.
safety.tier3: Recognition and multi-match only until language-specific review. Slash-separated alternatives may encode age, speaker gender, maternal/paternal side, register, relationship path, or another lexical subdivision and must not be flattened into one fake equivalent.
safety.all: A structurally complete row remains Machine created until language-specific review promotes it. Broad concept labels are game pivots, not claims that each language lexicalizes the relationship as one word.
